'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Chris Fanchi LS It Is The Future You See''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Chris Fanchi]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Chris Fanchi]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
